[SWS_DM_01395] Validation of
SOVD
operation
proximity_response
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
If a SOVD request body contains a
proximity_response
, the
Diagnostic
Server instance
shall call the method
ara::diag::SovdProximityChal-
lenge::ValidateResponse
with the parameter proximityResponse set to the con-
tent from the request body and consider the
proximity_challenge
valid, if
kProx-
imityChallengeValidationSuccessful
is returned.
⌋
